answer:
**Около 11.5% increase in odds** (OR = 1.115, 95% CI −21.8% … +59.0%) per each additional ongoing medical condition (MHONGO), controlling for BCG vaccination status and all patient interaction variables, per a proportional-odds ordinal regression (n=148).

Details:
- **Model**: cumulative-logit proportional-odds (statsmodels OrderedModel, BFGS, converged in 108 iters; 20 params = 17 covariates + 3 thresholds). β_n_ongoing = 0.1090 (SE 0.1810); (exp(β)−1)×100 = **11.51%**.
- **Design as approved**: primary outcome = AEPT=='COVID-19' with non-missing AESEV, peak (max) severity, levels 1<2<3<4 (n=148: 52/82/8/6); predictor = per-patient count of MH rows with MHONGO=='Yes' (0–4 in this set); controls = BCG (TRTGRP) + SEX, Age, RACE, education, work_hours, patients_seen, expect_interact (all categorical main effects; sparse tail levels RACE 4/5, work_hours >80 kept — no merging needed, model converged).
- **Proportional-odds check**: LRT vs separate logits chi2(34)=180.66, p<0.0001 (formal rejection; the separate-logit comparison hits perfect separation on sparse cells, so over-powered). PPOM with split-specific n_ongoing (likelihood verified to match statsmodels PO exactly at zero deltas): common β = −0.089 (SE 0.92 → −8.5%); split-specific total slopes −0.089 / +0.833 / +1.298 (avg +97.6%) — quasi-separated and unstable (PPOM NLL 0.96 vs PO 132.35). Per agreement, **primary answer stays proportional-odds: ~11.5%**.
- **Sensitivity table** (+1 ongoing condition):
  | spec | β | % inc | 95% CI |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | primary: exact COVID-19, peak SEV (n=148) | 0.1090 | **+11.5%** | −21.8% … +59.0% |
  | all COVID terms, peak SEV (n=151) | 0.1526 | +16.5% | −18.2% … +65.9% |
  | first-record severity (n=148) | −0.0006 | −0.06% | −30.0% … +42.6% |
  | PPOM split-specific, primary set | −0.0889 | −8.5% | −85.1% … +460.3% (unstable) |
